extraction.notes: Schedule 1 (printed p.16). The company's FFO-type subtotals are NAREIT FFO ($102,946), Pro forma FFO ($94,744, intermediate subtotal not in the tool schema), Run-Rate FFO ($86,555, used as core_total), and Run-Rate AFFO ($77,367). The Pro forma FFO reconciling items are included in core_adjustments so the chain ties to Run-Rate FFO. Pro forma FFO per share ($0.64) is not mapped to core_total; reported_per_share.core is Run-Rate FFO per share ($0.59). NAREIT FFO per share is not printed, so ffo is null. Diluted count 147,773 (thousands) reproduces $0.64, $0.59 and $0.52. Zero-valued Q3 items (loss on extinguishment of debt, Aimco note prepayment) shown as dashes in the filing. Category choices: 'Business transformation...' mapped to severance_restructuring; 'Leasing Commissions' has no matching category, so it is 'other'; 'Gain on dispositions and impairments' mapped to property_sale_gain_loss. AFFO already deducts Capital Replacements, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Footnote markers were stripped from labels where printed as '(1)', '(4)', etc.
